title: Your page: the website people book from
summary: Your page at usetikka.com/yourname shows your work, services, prices, hours and reviews. Put it in your bio.

steps.title: Open Your page
steps.body: On a phone, tap More, then Your page. On a computer, it's Your page in the menu on the left. Tap "See my page" any time to see it the way customers do.

steps.title: Add your services and prices
steps.body: Each service has a price (fixed, from, or ask me), how long it takes, and choices like short, medium or long with their own price and time. Add extras like a wash, and up to 3 questions to ask when someone books. Services for weddings and shoots can book a whole day.

steps.title: Add your work
steps.body: Add photos and short videos of what you've done. The best ones go first: people decide from the first few. A paid drop opens more room and collections, each with its own page.

steps.title: Pick a page style
steps.body: Under "Page style", choose the look that suits you: soft and light, luxe, or a gallery for photographers. Only the look changes; your services, bookings and reviews stay the same.

steps.title: Share your link
steps.body: Put usetikka.com/yourname in your Instagram and WhatsApp bio. When someone asks "How much?", send the link: they see your prices and free times and book on the spot.

tips: Clear, bright photos of finished work bring in more bookings than anything else on your page.
